description: This Dart source file defines classes and functions for managing API interactions in a Flutter application, including environment configuration, an API client with token handling, and error management.

classes.name: EnvConfig
classes.description: Provides environment-based configuration such as API base URLs and feature flags.

classes.name: ApiException
classes.description: Custom exception class for API-related errors, encapsulating status code, message, and optional data.

classes.name: ApiClient
classes.description: Handles HTTP requests with bearer token support, automatic token refresh, and error handling.

classes.name: ApiClientFactory
classes.description: Factory class to produce configured ApiClient instances, integrating with shared preferences for token storage.

classes.name: AuthStorageKeys
classes.description: Defines string keys used to store authentication tokens and user info in shared preferences.

methods.name: EnvConfig.apiBaseUrl
methods.description: Gets the base URL for REST API, from environment variables or default to localhost.

methods.name: EnvConfig.wsBaseUrl
methods.description: Gets the WebSocket base URL from environment variables or default to localhost.

methods.name: EnvConfig.useMocks
methods.description: Returns a boolean indicating whether to use mock services based on environment variable.

methods.name: EnvConfig.stripePublishableKey
methods.description: Optional Stripe publishable key from environment.

methods.name: ApiException.toString
methods.description: Overrides the default string representation to include status code and message.

methods.name: ApiClient._defaultHeaders
methods.description: Creates default HTTP headers, including authorization if token provided.

methods.name: ApiClient._uri
methods.description: Constructs a full Uri object from a path and optional query parameters.

methods.name: ApiClient._sendWithRefresh
methods.description: Sends HTTP requests with automatic token refresh on 401/403 responses.

methods.name: ApiClient._decodeBody
methods.description: Decodes HTTP response body to a specified type, with error handling.

methods.name: ApiClient._handle
methods.description: Checks HTTP response status and decodes or throws ApiException.

methods.name: ApiClient.get
methods.description: Performs an HTTP GET request for a given path and query parameters.

methods.name: ApiClient.post
methods.description: Performs an HTTP POST request with optional body and headers.

methods.name: ApiClient.put
methods.description: Performs an HTTP PUT request with a body.

methods.name: ApiClientFactory.create
methods.description: Creates an ApiClient instance wired to shared preferences for token storage, with custom refresh logic.

methods.name: AuthStorageKeys
methods.description: Contains static constants for shared preferences keys related to authentication.
